rounds.summary: Fixed the broken order form — the JS looked up a non-existent id ('orderform' vs 'order-form'), so no order ever registered — by wiring up a working submit handler with required fields, a drink datalist tied to the menu, and an inline confirmation, while removing the banned marquee and Comic Sans and fixing the viewport so the page actually converts on a 375px screen.

Added a pickup-time selector to the order form so customers can say when they want their drink ready, making the order actionable and the confirmation message specific — a small, real conversion feature rather than decoration.
Added a muffin upsell checkbox tied to the existing '50 cents off muffins' promo plus a live order total, so the promo actually drives add-on sales and customers see the price before committing.

Added a one-tap "Just a coffee" express button that pre-fills the most popular order (medium coffee, ASAP) and drops the customer straight onto the name field, cutting mobile order friction from five fields to one.

Added a sticky mobile order bar that pins the running total and an Order Now button to the bottom of the viewport once the customer scrolls past the form, so the order is always one tap away instead of lost above the fold.

Added a one-tap 'Reorder your usual' button that appears after a customer's first order (saved to localStorage), prefilled with their last drink, size, pickup, and name and labeled with the exact items and price, so repeat coffee runs — the bulk of a coffee shop's business — convert in a single tap.

Turned the mobile sticky order bar into a true one-tap checkout: it now shows a live order summary (items, total, and ready time) and its Order Now button submits the order directly — scrolling to the first missing field only when the order is incomplete — removing the scroll-back-to-form step that killed mobile conversions.
Turned the static dot-leader menu into tappable order cards that pre-fill the form and jump the customer straight to it, cutting the path from 'I want that' to checkout.

Added a post-order bump: the instant an order is placed, one-tap 'Add another drink' buttons (Coffee/Big/Fancy/Tea) refill the form and submit immediately, capturing 'ordering for a friend' sales that would otherwise require refilling the whole form.
Added a one-tap Coffee + Muffin combo card at the top of the menu and turned the promo banner into a link to it, so the muffin attachment sells in a single tap and average order value rises.
